_comment: S11 Workstream B (the moonshot active tracker): = sitl3_lanes_vision.json geometry (convoy_3lane world, 3 diverging straight lanes, save_marker_frames ON) but each drone runs the track_convoy phase instead of sentry_scan — it locks ONE car's unique ArUco id (track_marker_ids) and bearing-pursues the moving car, keeping it under the nadir camera, then gives up cleanly on budget and lands. DRONE<->CAR: alpha->7, bravo->23, charlie->88 (per-drone zone.track_convoy.track_marker_ids). approach_enabled true: sim is exactly where open-loop translation is PROVEN (gate-E discipline keeps it OFF on real HULA until move/rotate accuracy is measured onsite). Pursuit is bearing-based (Rotate to center on bearing_deg, then Move FORWARD), bounded by max_chase_cm (open-loop runaway cap) and investigate_budget_s (wall-clock give-up). Run via sim/run_vision.sh track3 (PX4_GZ_WORLD=convoy_3lane + a straight slow convoy on 7/23/88). Endpoints/ports/timeouts identical to sitl3_lanes_vision.json. TUNED (2026-06-10). First VM run lost bravo's car ~16s in; pure tuning (band/step) only masked it (charlie's big footprint hid an over-walk: the law stepped FORWARD on a centered BEARING even with the slow car already UNDER the drone, walking small-footprint drones off their cars). ROOT FIX = a nadir DEADBAND in track_convoy.py (center_px_frac, default 0.30): hold while the marker is near frame-centre, step only once it drifts off-centre. With over-walk fixed, the steps go back to keep-up sizing (approach_cm 40, track_dwell_s 0.5) so a drone tracks a MOVING car; lost_timeout_s 4->8 rides brief blips. Cars driven at CONVOY_LINEAR 0.08 (run_vision.sh track3) so the chase is visibly a chase, not 3 drones parked over still cars. BANDS (alpha 2.6 / bravo 2.4 / charlie 2.2): across 3 VM runs only charlie (2.2) kept its car in frame the WHOLE 120s chase; the smaller-footprint drones (1.2/2.0) drifted off their moving cars under open-loop move/rotate error and gave up. So all 3 now sit at charlie-class footprints, worst-performer HIGHEST (a higher drone both has a bigger footprint AND sees a smaller per-move angular marker shift = steadier tracking), distinct per the sitl vertical-separation guard. charlie at 2.2 logged 460+ sightings = big detection margin, so 2.4/2.6 are safe for the ~20 px marker. VM-TUNE on the box: CONVOY_LINEAR (car speed vs the drone's chase rate), approach_cm/max_step_deg/track_dwell_s (chase aggression vs lockstep RTF ~0.86), max_chase_cm (arena size). lead_gain stays 0 (azimuth lead needs onsite calibration); core is fixed-step bearing pursuit.
